data.question: Write a program that reads two integers A and B and prints "Greater than or Equal to 60" when A ** 2 + B ** 2 is greater than 60, otherwise "Less than 60".

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads two integers A and B and prints "Greater than or Equal to 60" when A ** 2 + B ** 2 is greater than 60, otherwise "Less than 60".

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: The comparison is strictly greater than 60 even though the greater message says "Greater than or Equal to 60".
